sensors.Sentinel-2: 10 m optical - vigour, canopy moisture, greenness
sensors.CHIRPS: daily rainfall - separates drought from crop problems
sensors.ERA5-Land: FAO-56 inputs, growing degree days, heat stress
sensors.NOAA GFS: 7-day outlook, ~28 km - scheme scale, not field scale
sensors.OpenLandMap: soil texture, 250 m - explains standing differences

reference_provenance.reference_source: NEIGHBOURHOOD: 3000 m buffer around the field
reference_provenance.buffer_basis: ARBITRARY: 3 km is wide enough to contain other fields and narrow enough to stay in the same soil and climate

vigour.name: vigour
vigour.threshold_basis: DERIVED: median - 2.0 * robust sigma over the neighbourhood, computed this run
vigour.interpretation: Crop vigour. The headline health number, and the slowest to move.

canopy_moisture.name: canopy_moisture
canopy_moisture.threshold_basis: DERIVED: median - 2.0 * robust sigma over the neighbourhood, computed this run
canopy_moisture.interpretation: Canopy water content. Falls BEFORE visible vigour does, so it is the earlier of the two warnings.

greenness.name: greenness
greenness.threshold_basis: DERIVED: median - 2.0 * robust sigma over the neighbourhood, computed this run
greenness.interpretation: Enhanced vegetation index. Less prone to saturating over a dense canopy than NDVI.

thermal_stress.interpretation: Land surface temperature. A transpiring crop is cooler than a stressed one, so a field warm relative to its neighbours is a direct water-stress signal - and it moves days before vigour does.
thermal_stress.difference_basis: ARBITRARY: 1 degC is the band treated as indistinguishable

rainfall.sampled_as: the CHIRPS cell containing this field (5500 m); rainfall is not resolved at field scale by any dataset here
rainfall.why: Without rainfall context, a stressed field cannot be told apart from a dry season. The two need different actions.

soil.caveat: A global model, not a soil test. Useful for explaining differences between fields; not a substitute for sampling.

series.note: Cloud-screened scenes only. Gaps in the series are cloud, not crop failure.

provenance.method: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith, eq. 6, G = 0 at daily step
provenance.note: ET0 is computed from an 11 km region mean, not per pixel. A per-pixel ET0 raster would present 11 km of information at 10 m resolution.

water_requirement.interpretation: Reference evapotranspiration: what a short, well-watered grass surface would transpire here.

canopy_series.basis: ARBITRARY: gaps longer than 30 days are left empty rather than bridged, and nothing is extrapolated before the first or after the last observation.

water_requirement.etc_method: sum over days of Kcb(NDVI on that day) * ET0 on that day - the integral, not the product of the two season means
water_requirement.kcb_basis: ARBITRARY: Kcb = -0.1 + 1.44 * NDVI, published coefficients from other regions and crops, clamped to [0.0, 1.15]. Not validated in Sudan. Weighted by each day's ET0, not a season mean.
water_requirement.etc_caveat: This is water REQUIRED, not water DELIVERED. Nothing in this engine measures delivery to a field.

yield_estimate.caveat: Canopy greenness is not yield. Grain fill, harvest losses and terminal stress all break the relationship after the canopy has already been measured.
yield_estimate.reason: no calibrated yield model exists for sorghum; at least 30 local harvest measurements are needed before any tonnage is quoted

phenology.basis: ARBITRARY: green-up is the first crossing of 0.5 of the seasonal amplitude. Days are counted from the start of the season window, and cloud gaps mean the true crossing may fall earlier than the first scene that shows it.

climate.heat_stress_basis: ARBITRARY: published crop figure, not a Sudanese trial

dry_spells.basis: ARBITRARY: hand-chosen dry-spell length and rain floor

nutrition.caveat: Chlorophyll indices respond to nitrogen, and also to water stress, salinity, disease, sulphur and iron deficiency and heat. A low value identifies a struggling crop; it does not by itself identify the cause.

limitations: Thermal is 100 m: on a field under about 2 ha every pixel mixes the crop with its surroundings.

Nutrition is a RELATIVE chlorophyll condition unless a calibrated model exists for this crop. Nitrogen has no direct spectral signature; water stress, salinity, disease and heat all lower chlorophyll too.
Crop water requirement is what the crop NEEDED. Nothing here measures what it received.
Yield is refused without local harvest calibration.
The 7-day outlook is a ~28 km global model: the weather over the area, not over a field. No alert is raised from it.
Soil texture is a global model at 250 m, not a soil test.
Field rankings are an ordering, not a calibrated health score.

ranking.basis: Fields ordered by whether vigour fell below the neighbourhood threshold, then by vigour. This is an ordering, not a score: no calibrated health scale exists, and one is not invented here.
ranking.unmeasured_note: Fields with no usable vigour reading are listed separately, not ranked last. Unmeasured is neither healthy nor sick.

provenance.note: A ~28 km global model. This is the outlook over the scheme, not over a field. Rainfall is the least skilful variable in it.

forecast.caveat: A forecast is not a measurement. Nothing else in this platform depends on it, and no alert is raised from it.

note: DEMONSTRATION DATA. These are REAL satellite measurements, computed live from Earth Engine, over four ARBITRARY 40-hectare squares placed on the Gezira plain near Wad Medani. They belong to no farm and to no farmer. They exist so the farmer app has something to draw when the repository is first cloned. Do not cite any figure here as a measurement of anyone's field: the imagery is real and the field boundaries are invented, which is the most misleading of the possible combinations.
note_ar: بيانات عرض توضيحي. هذه قياسات أقمار صناعية حقيقية، محسوبة حيًّا من Earth Engine، فوق أربعة مربّعات اعتباطية مساحة كلٍّ منها 40 هكتارًا على سهل الجزيرة قرب ود مدني. لا تخصّ أي مزرعة ولا أي مزارع. وُضعت كي يجد تطبيق المزارع ما يرسمه عند أول استنساخ للمستودع. لا تُقتبس أي قيمة هنا كقياس لحقل أحد: الصور حقيقية والحدود مخترعة، وهي أكثر التركيبات تضليلًا.
limitations_ar: الحرارة تُقاس عند 100 متر: في حقل دون هكتارين تقريبًا يخلط كل بكسل المحصولَ بما حوله.
التغذية حالة كلوروفيل نسبية ما لم يوجد نموذج معايَر لهذا المحصول. وللنيتروجين لا بصمة طيفية مباشرة؛ فإجهاد الماء والملوحة والمرض والحرارة تخفض الكلوروفيل كذلك.
احتياج المحصول من الماء هو ما احتاجه المحصول. ولا شيء هنا يقيس ما وصله فعلًا.
الإنتاجية مرفوضة دون معايرة حصاد محلية.
توقّعات الأيام السبعة نموذج عالمي بدقّة نحو 28 كم: طقس المنطقة لا طقس الحقل. ولا يُرفع منها أي إنذار.
قوام التربة نموذج عالمي عند 250 مترًا، لا تحليل تربة.
ترتيب الحقول ترتيب، لا درجة صحّة معايَرة.
